research_question: Does the K=1 plus Mkt-RF hybrid improve on FF5 plus momentum jointly in pricing distance, raw Euler moments and alpha?
candidate: Each of five paired V015 K=1 factors concatenated with Mkt-RF.
benchmark: Ken French five factors plus momentum.
loading_case: Strict factor self-pricing loadings estimated in 2000-2009 and frozen for 2010-2019.
inference: Five-seed candidate summary plus 500-draw circular 12-month development-period block bootstrap of seed-mean candidate-minus-benchmark differences.
interpretation_rule: The hybrid passes only if its seed-mean candidate-minus-benchmark differences are nonpositive for gamma-zero distance, gamma-one distance, mean absolute Euler moment and mean absolute alpha; both distance bootstrap 95% upper bounds are nonpositive; and at least four of five seeds jointly weakly improve raw moments and alpha. Otherwise retain it only as mechanism evidence.
boundary: No retraining, tuning, dimension selection or sealed-period access. A failed gate cannot be relaxed after inspection.
